summary: Tightened the prose, restored the 'as of August 2026' dating on status claims, converted concluded EU roles (vera.ai, PROMPT, JRC expert group) to the past tense, corrected the overstated 'European Parliament inquiries' to the single written question to the European Commission, and added the omitted Urbino doctorate.

flags.claim: formal citation within European Parliament inquiries
flags.issue: The authoritative biography supports only that the 2025 working paper was cited in a single written question to the European Commission (document E-10-2026-000086); 'inquiries' (plural, and implying a formal parliamentary inquiry) asserts a stronger institutional action than any source states. Corrected to 'a written question to the European Commission'.

flags.claim: leading Work Package 4 on the Horizon Europe vera.ai consortium and participating as a partner on the PROMPT project
flags.issue: Both roles are concluded per the authoritative biography (vera.ai ended October 2025, PROMPT February 2026); the present-participle framing reads as ongoing. Rewritten in the past tense with conclusion dates.

flags.claim: contributing scientific oversight to the Joint Research Centre's work on Very Large Online Platforms
flags.issue: The authoritative biography states this role in the past tense ('was a member', reports 'delivered in 2026'); the present-tense framing turns a completed appointment into an ongoing one. Rewritten in the past tense.

flags.claim: acting as a proposal evaluator for EACEA
flags.issue: The authoritative biography stamps this status 'as of August 2026' with the appointment running to September 2026; the biography presents it as a timeless present-tense role. Restored the dated status.

flags.claim: Fabio Giglietto is Full Professor of Internet Studies
flags.issue: Current-status claims (professorship, memberships, Digit Srl partnership, MINE's active status) are stamped 'as of August 2026' in the authoritative biography but were stated as timeless present in the draft. Dating restored in the revision.
The authoritative biography states he earned his doctorate at the University of Urbino; the draft dropped this. Restored.

flags.claim: Complementing his academic commitments, he is a founding partner of Digit Srl
flags.issue: Throat-clearing opener ('Complementing his academic commitments') and similar filler ('Internationally, he has held key research roles') add no information; tightened throughout.
